column1: # scripts/tests/check_rules_2i.sh. Columns: rule, fixture, expected (reject:<code>:<RULE@version> or
# run:<exit status>), pair (shared by a reject row and the run row of its rewritten program), modes.
# Rows are referenced, not copied: existing fixtures keep their run_tests.sh rows as well.
# Not here, because the rule is not enforced yet (each a §15.7 gap with an owner): REF-1 for a trait
# method declaration (G13) and an extern raw pointer to a reference (G15); REF-2 through a type alias or a
# field type (G16); REF-5 for a borrow of a literal, call result or aggregate literal (G12); REF-8 for a
# move of the owner inside an arm bound through `match &o` (G17).
